description: Env file parse. A .env file body in, URL-encoded as the env query parameter (up to 12,000 bytes), a parsed document out: the vars map with dotenv string values, a convention typing guess per value, the full line and value statistics, and every finding with its line number (malformed lines, invalid keys, duplicate keys, lowercase keys). Price: $0.10 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.

env.description: The .env file body to parse (up to 12,000 bytes).

name: env-parse
